# Activity Vault

The all-in-one activity archive for teachers and after-school program teachers.
Hundreds of real, classic, public-domain activity concepts — filterable by age, time,
group size, materials, and category. Plan-my-week planner. Printable one-page cards.

## Categories
- Seasons: 22 activities — Activities that ride the turning year — fall leaves, winter making, spring planting, summer play.
- Holidays: 25 activities — Festive projects and games for the days the whole group looks forward to.
- Crafts: 53 activities — Hands-on making: fold it, paint it, build it, take it home.
- STEM: 37 activities — Experiments, engineering challenges, and satisfying science demos.
- PE & Movement: 38 activities — Run, jump, dance — activities that burn off the wiggles.
- Team & Community: 35 activities — Turn a group into a crew: cooperation, trust, and belonging.
- Icebreakers: 26 activities — First-day friendly: learn names, laugh, and loosen up fast.
- Outdoor: 34 activities — Fresh-air activities for fields, playgrounds, and nature walks.
- Rainy Day: 28 activities — Stuck inside? These keep a roomful of kids happy without a gym.
- Quiet & Focus: 43 activities — Wind-down worthy: calm, creative, individual or small-group.
- Music & Rhythm: 7 activities — Drums, shakers, rhythm games, and songs — make some noise.

## API
- api/v1/activities.json — full activity records
- api/v1/categories.json — category definitions
- api/v1/filters.json — filter configuration
- api/v1/schema/activity.schema.json — JSON schema

- skills/sub-tub-rescue.md

## Tools
- sub.html — Sub Tub: the substitute-teacher rescue kit.
  Pick grade band, minutes to fill, materials on hand, location —
  generates a sequenced print-ready emergency plan plus a 'Dear sub' note template.

## Docs
- API.md — full API reference
- PIPELINE.md — how the library grows
